issues.span: But those with wisdom fly freely like birds in the sky.
issues.evidence: The wise roam freely because they know beings are like deer caught in a snare; the 'knowing' is dropped.
issues.fix: Knowing that confused beings are like deer caught in a trap, those with wisdom fly freely like birds in the sky.

issues.span: They also do not find things.
issues.evidence: Text says they do not apprehend all phenomena (ཆོས་ཀུན་, 'all things'); 'all' is lost.
issues.fix: They do not find any of the things either.

issues.span: They have already served billions of Buddhas.
issues.evidence: 'Many tens of billions' of Buddhas (བྱེ་བ་ཁྲག་ཁྲིག་མང་), not simply billions.
issues.fix: They have served many, many billions of Buddhas.

issues.span: beautiful forests where the cowherds work
issues.evidence: Excellent forests at the cowherds' boundary (མཚམས), i.e. the edge of their land, not where they work.
issues.fix: beautiful forests at the edge of the cowherds' land

issues.span: those who fully enter the highest awakening hear this perfect wisdom
issues.evidence: Such people 'should be known as hearing' this perfect wisdom (རིག་པར་བྱ); the 'should be known' is lost.
issues.fix: You should know that those who fully enter the highest awakening are hearing this perfect wisdom of the Victorious Ones.

issues.evidence: Text says searching for sutras (མདོ་ཚོལ); 'other' is not there.
Text says 'always subject to much harm' (འཚེ་བ), i.e. often harmed, not merely in danger.

issues.span: She is their Mother in every world system.
issues.evidence: Wisdom 'who has become their Mother' (ཡུམ་གྱུར); 'in every world system' is not said of the Mother.
